responsibility: Defines the token and reserved-word vocabulary for the gm2 lexer and parser. It exports the `toktype` enumeration, interned `NameKey` values for punctuation and language keywords, and conversion routines that classify a name as reserved and map token enum values back to interned names, making it the canonical token dictionary shared by scanning and parsing passes.
same_name_distinction: This `.def` file defines the exported token vocabulary—`toktype`, reserved-word names, and lookup routines—while the same-name `.mod` file populates and maintains the actual name↔token tables.
